description.narrative:
Project Description The Leadership for Change (LFC) Project will be implemented by The Co-operative University of Kenya (CUK) at its Karen campus and partner facilities, targeting We Effect partner organizations across Kenya. The project's main purpose is to strengthen cooperative and farmer-based organizations through leadership capacity building. It aims to equip leaders with skills in governance, entrepreneurship, gender equality, climate change mitigation, and change management to enhance organizational performance and inclusivity. Expected results include:
Improved governance and democratic practices in partner organizations. Increased gender equality and youth inclusion in leadership roles (70% of participants will be women). Enhanced advocacy capacity and organizational resilience.
Target group: Leaders from We Effect partner organizations, cooperative CEOs, and farmer-based groups, with deliberate focus on women and youth. Main activities:
Conduct four training arenas covering visionary leadership, personal growth, entrepreneurship, and change management. Integrate gender equality, climate change, and financial inclusion modules. Provide mentorship, coaching, and post-training support. Facilitate advocacy and policy engagement workshops.
The project aligns with We Effect's strategy on gender equality, sustainable livelihoods, and resilience, creating empowered leaders who drive inclusive socio-economic transformation.
